name: The Reality Foundry
description: A solo AI filmmaking project behind the sci-fi series The Sky-Fallen Legacy.
descriptionMore: Releases a serialized sci-fi epic built frame by frame with generative video tools, including Dreamina and Pippit AI. The studio's only release so far is The Sky-Fallen Legacy, a 13-episode series following Ethan's crash-landing on an uncharted alien planet and the generations-spanning war he is drawn into.
